problem: The structural-member relationship has no sh:minCount, so a ship with no structural member can satisfy the nested formula prerequisites syntactically while the SPARQL constraint produces no result and therefore does not enforce A_w >= A_t.
required_change: Add sh:minCount 1 to the nltl:hasStructuralMember property shape so at least one structural member carrying frame spacing, AF, and required transverse frame shear area is mandatory.
regression_guard: Preserve the ship-to-structural-member path and require at least one linked structural member for formula evaluation.
